description: This file implements the Lua I/O library functions, providing file handling, reading, writing, and closing functionalities for Lua scripts. It defines methods for file operations and manages file handles within the Lua environment.

methods.name: pushresult
methods.description: Pushes the result of a file operation onto the Lua stack, indicating success or error with message and error code.

methods.name: fileerror
methods.description: Handles file error by pushing error message and raising Lua argument error.

methods.name: io_type
methods.description: Determines if the Lua object is a file, closed file, or not a file.

methods.name: tofile
methods.description: Retrieves the FILE pointer from Lua userdata, raising error if file is closed.

methods.name: newfile
methods.description: Creates a new userdata for a file handle with a closed state.

methods.name: io_noclose
methods.description: Function to prevent closing standard files.

methods.name: io_pclose
methods.description: Closes a 'popen' file handle.

methods.name: io_fclose
methods.description: Closes a regular file handle.

methods.name: aux_close
methods.description: Calls the __close method of a file object.

methods.name: io_close
methods.description: Closes a file, handling default and regular files.

methods.name: io_gc
methods.description: Garbage collector method to close file handle if open.

methods.name: io_tostring
methods.description: Returns string representation of file handle or closed file.

methods.name: io_open
methods.description: Opens a file with given filename and mode.

methods.name: io_popen
methods.description: Opens a process pipe as a file handle.

methods.name: io_tmpfile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file handle.

methods.name: getiofile
methods.description: Retrieves standard IO file handle from Lua environment.

methods.name: g_iofile
methods.description: Gets or sets the file associated with a standard IO stream.

methods.name: io_input
methods.description: Sets or gets the input file handle.

methods.name: io_output
methods.description: Sets or gets the output file handle.

methods.name: io_readline
methods.description: Reads a line from a file (used internally).

methods.name: aux_lines
methods.description: Creates an iterator for lines in a file.

methods.name: f_lines
methods.description: Creates an iterator for lines in a file handle.

methods.name: io_lines
methods.description: Creates an iterator over lines from a file or filename.

methods.name: read_number
methods.description: Reads a number from a file.

methods.name: test_eof
methods.description: Tests for end-of-file condition.

methods.name: read_line
methods.description: Reads a line from a file.

methods.name: read_chars
methods.description: Reads a specified number of characters from a file.

methods.name: g_read
methods.description: Generic read function supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: io_read
methods.description: Reads data from the default input.

methods.name: f_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specific file handle.

methods.name: io_readline
methods.description: Reads a line from a file handle (used internally).

methods.name: g_write
methods.description: Generic write function for file output.

methods.name: io_write
methods.description: Writes data to the default output.

methods.name: f_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specific file handle.

methods.name: f_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in a file.

methods.name: f_setvbuf
methods.description: Sets buffer mode for a file.

methods.name: io_flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer.

methods.name: f_flush
methods.description: Flushes a specific file handle.

methods.name: luaopen_io
methods.description: Initializes the Lua I/O library, setting up file handles and methods.
